findings.title: Pull-request code runs on shared self-hosted infrastructure
findings.summary: A lower-trust PR admitted to run can change a local action, build script, test or generator and execute it with self-hosted runner privileges. Four workflows share this missing isolation boundary; the local cache action documents private tokenless cache connectivity and reused checkout/disk.

severity.rationale: Runner-account code execution and private network access can compromise shared CI state. High potential impact has medium likelihood because GitHub PR approvals and external runner isolation are unknown. Confirmed disposable provisioning without shared authority would lower severity; automatic untrusted runs with trusted state would raise it.

confidence.rationale: Source establishes PR execution and shared cache/disk; actual runner lifecycle and external PR approval policy were not inspected.

codeEvidence.label: CI PR trigger
codeEvidence.explanation: A lower-trust PR can trigger jobs, subject to platform approval.

codeEvidence.label: PR checkout executes on self-hosted
codeEvidence.code:
lint:
    name: fmt + clippy
    runs-on: self-hosted
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@89b12181fb390509a0842a86cc55eeb8eb928c1d # stable branch, pinned 2026-10-01
        with:
          components: rustfmt, clippy
          # jubarte-wasm is linted for the target it ships on.
          targets: wasm32-unknown-unknown
      - uses: ./.github/actions/mbx
      - run: cargo fmt --check
      - run: cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
codeEvidence.explanation: The checkout supplies the local action and Cargo/build inputs to a self-hosted runner.

codeEvidence.label: Self-hosted test leg
codeEvidence.code:
test:
    name: test (${{ matrix.os }})
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [self-hosted, macos-latest, windows-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      # tests/corpus keeps the bench's file names, some past Windows'
      # 260-character path limit.
      - run: git config --global core.longpaths true
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@89b12181fb390509a0842a86cc55eeb8eb928c1d # stable branch, pinned 2026-10-01
      - if: matrix.os == 'self-hosted'
        uses: ./.github/actions/mbx
      - if: matrix.os != 'self-hosted'
        uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@6323deb102c322ba6fcbdcafc7e3dddab59af2b6 # v2.9.2
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@72f835688cb6c15903b796f704b01e652a2b8835 # cargo-llvm-cov tag, pinned 2026-10-01
        with:
          tool: cargo-nextest
      # Every failing test, not just the first binary's (the `ci` profile
      # does not fail fast), with JUnit XML for Codecov's test results.
      # The strict Markdown round trip is red until the reader work lands
      # (spec 2026-10-13 §5.4); md-roundtrip.yml is its gate, so this job
      # keeps reporting every other test.
      - run: cargo nextest run --all-features --profile ci -E 'not test(markdown_and_docx_round_trip_exactly)'
codeEvidence.explanation: PR test code executes in the self-hosted matrix leg.

codeEvidence.label: PR shell scripts execute
codeEvidence.code:
- name: run every example
        env:
          JUBARTE: ${{ github.workspace }}/target/release/jubarte
          # 17-mcp serves this checkout's Python package, not the PyPI release.
          JUBARTE_MCP_FROM: jubarte-redlines[mcp] @ ${{ github.workspace }}/jubarte-python
        run: |
          failed=0
          for script in examples/adoption/*/run.sh; do
            echo "::group::$script"
            if bash "$script"; then echo "ok: $script"; else echo "::error file=$script::exited $?"; failed=1; fi
            echo "::endgroup::"
          done
          exit "$failed"
codeEvidence.explanation: All checked-out example run.sh files execute with runner authority.

codeEvidence.label: Self-hosted docs execution
codeEvidence.code:
jobs:
  drift:
    name: generated docs drift
    runs-on: self-hosted
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@89b12181fb390509a0842a86cc55eeb8eb928c1d # stable branch, pinned 2026-10-01
      - uses: ./.github/actions/mbx
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@c18668ad3cf93ea998bef934396af7bb5c839dc7 # v10.2.0
      # The generator runs jubarte-wasm/cli/bin/jubarte-redlines.mjs against
      # the checked-in jubarte-wasm build. That CLI is ESM and engines-declares
      # node >= 18.3 (jubarte-wasm/cli/package.json); the self-hosted runner's
      # system node predates ESM (`import` is a SyntaxError), so a real node is
      # set up here instead of trusting the image.
      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: "24"
      - name: Regenerate and compare
        run: scripts/gen_docs.sh --check
codeEvidence.explanation: PR-owned local action and generator execute on self-hosted.

codeEvidence.label: Shared private cache and reused disk
codeEvidence.code:
# The self-hosted runners share one mbx cache server on their private Docker
# network (`mbx-cache`), so a crate one runner compiled is a cache hit on the
# others. The server takes no token: mbx sends none over plain HTTP, and only
# the runners can reach it. mbx publishes only from pushes to a protected
# branch; pull requests read. GitHub-hosted runners cannot reach the server,
# so jobs that also run there keep Swatinem/rust-cache on those legs.
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - uses: jdx/mr-boxington-action@47ce49b32025d93a7a2f4570815afaa2b7092240 # v1.7.2
      with:
        backend: remote
        version: "1.24.1"
        remote-url: http://mbx-cache:7543
        namespace: jandira-tech/jubarte-redlines
        # Linked test binaries are the largest outputs by far: with
        # them cached, one test job left an 84 GiB store and a 79 GiB target
        # on 2026-10-17, and uploads drained at 1 MB/s. Cache compilations only.
        cache-links: "false"
    # Every job on a runner builds in the same checkout, so mbx always counts
    # that checkout's managed target as the most recently used and never
    # collects it: on 2026-10-17 three of them reached 69-220 GiB in a few
    # hours and filled the disk the four runners share. Each job now starts
    # from an empty target, restored from the store and the cache server,
    # and each runner's store keeps to a fixed share of the disk.
codeEvidence.explanation: The cache is tokenless and reachable from runners, shares main namespace, and comments describe shared checkouts/disk. Server enforcement is unavailable.

rootCause.summary: PR-triggered jobs execute the PR checkout on shared self-hosted infrastructure without a source-enforced trusted-ref gate or disposable isolation. Token restrictions do not constrain arbitrary runner processes.

findings.remediation: Run lower-trust PR builds/tests/generators on GitHub-hosted or one-job disposable runners without trusted writable state or private infrastructure connectivity. Separate trusted main runners and enforce cache write authorization server-side. Apply consistently to ci, adoption, docs and md-roundtrip.

counterEvidence: contents:read and persist-credentials:false restrict GitHub token use, not runner process authority.
Fork PR approval is an external execution prerequisite.
Disposable runner configuration and server-side cache read/write enforcement are not available.
Release uses hosted runners; no direct release compromise is asserted.
limitations: Persistence/cache poisoning are conditional, not demonstrated.
Actual GitHub approvals and runner lifecycle remain unknown.
validation.summary: Parent independently read all four workflows and the composite action, verified all PR triggers and affected runner/script selections, and confirmed documented shared resources. No live CI/cache probe was performed.

dataflow.summary: PR-owned checkout -> local action/Cargo/test/docs/example script -> self-hosted runner process -> runner filesystem/private network.
dataflow.outcome: arbitrary runner-account execution and private CI network reachability

impact.why: Potential trusted CI compromise from persistent state/private infrastructure access.

likelihood.why: PR admission and actual external isolation are unknown.

reachability.summary: A contributor submits a PR and any required platform approval allows the run. No repository write permission or privileged GitHub token is required after code executes.
preconditions: Configured self-hosted resources exist; external isolation determines persistence impact.

attackPath.summary: An allowed PR changes a local action, build script, test or generator; workflow checkout executes it on self-hosted and exposes runner-account resources.

remediationTests: Verify every PR-reachable job selects isolated runner infrastructure.
Verify PR runners cannot access trusted cache writes or retained trusted-job state.

originalCandidate.title: Untrusted pull-request code executes on self-hosted runner with shared cache access
originalCandidate.originalEvidence: Baseline initial candidate: .github/workflows/ci.yml triggers unrestricted pull_request lines 13-17; lint/test/coverage/MSRV/fuzz/package/python use self-hosted and execute PR-controlled ./.github/actions/mbx and cargo/test code (36,46-48;77-99). .github/actions/mbx/action.yml documents shared private Docker cache at unauthenticated http://mbx-cache:7543 with namespace shared with main. No fork/trusted-author gate or disposable isolation in reviewed source.
originalCandidate.counterEvidence: External GitHub approval settings and actual runner lifecycle are unknown; conditional exposure requires a lower-trust PR being permitted to run.

provenance.parentCalibration: medium severity/confidence due unverified isolation and PR-run admission.

surfaces.label: Pull-request CI and private shared cache
surfaces.notes: ci.yml, adoption.yml, docs.yml, md-roundtrip.yml execute PR checkout on self-hosted. Root action8-32 documents shared cache/disk. External approval/isolation unknown.

candidate.title: EOCD preindex selection may bypass max_entries
candidate.originalEvidence: Parser review candidate: admission preindex_budget selects last bare EOCD magic/count without validating it (src/admission.rs:590-601), while zip 9.0.5 reportedly skips invalid EOCD candidates and retries earlier records. A 22-byte fake EOCD in real comment with low count and impossible central directory offset may pass max_entries then index real overlimit archive; archive.len() only checked for less than declared at449-455.
candidate.counterEvidence: Parent has not verified dependency selection semantics; static tracing in progress, no reproduction.

candidate.title: DTD contents may bypass XML policy before permissive DOM recursion
candidate.originalEvidence: Admission ignores Event::DocType at src/admission.rs:798-820; permissive DOM skips <!… only through first > (src/xmllinq/parse.rs:539-543). quick-xml0.42 DtdParser reportedly keeps quoted <!ENTITY> contents inside one DocType event. Quoted entity replacement text containing nested markup may be uncounted by max_xml_depth/tag policy then recursively parsed by parse_element:660-662 via WmlDocument::main_document:94.
candidate.counterEvidence: Static candidate only; parent verification and detailed reachability/counterevidence in progress; no triggering input executed.

candidate.title: Relationship-selected XML with non-XML suffix bypasses admission XML policy
candidate.originalEvidence: Admission scans .xml/.rels only at src/admission.rs533-544 and separately nonstandard main at556-569. Auxiliary XML relationship target arbitrary suffix may pass as binary: document_comparer.rs4724-4750 resolves footnote/endnote by relationship type then part_string and unchecked parse; deeply nested word/notes.bin may reach recursive DOM despite max_xml_depth.
candidate.counterEvidence: Parent validation and sibling revision paths pending; no runtime input created.

openQuestions: External GitHub PR approval, runner disposal and cache-server authority are not supplied.
